pairs.why: B's keys have soft rounded edges with narrow dark gaps and crisp numerals like the real calculator, while A has a hard bright silver bezel and thick separated key blocks.
A's water is covered in busy caustic lines and has a tiny, edge-heavy pier, while B keeps water edges calm and puts the pier in large, clearly bounded shapes like the real card.
A's hat has soft tonal edges with no outline, while B has a hard rim highlight on the brim and a darker, crisper contour.
B has moderate edge density and a lit door and steps with soft contours like the real cards, while A has thick white dome ribs and a busy gray ground.
A has a smooth body with a few soft shape edges, while B adds many droplet edges that the real bottle doesn't have.
A's leaf clusters are softer and denser with shadow-led edges like the real topiary, while B has large, crisp, bright leaf edges and extra background clutter.
A has slightly fewer small crisp edges, with no open-mouth interior and fewer stray pebbles, so it is marginally closer to the real duck's smooth, clean contours.
A has bigger, calmer checker edges and a softer marble surface, while B has finer, denser checker lines and sharper vein edges.
